calculation.description: Uses the 120-trading-day return ending 10 sessions before the decision, divided by 40-day realized volatility; the negative direction rewards medium-term relative losers while avoiding the most recent 10-day reversal horizon. All inputs are lagged and causal.

validation.regime_notes: Inverse-direction factor has positive predictive interpretation after sign reversal. Raw IC was negative in all regimes: 2026-27 -0.123768 (318 dates), 2028-29 -0.102620 (521 dates), and 2030-33 -0.051355 (977 dates). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty; every date used at least 8 valid assets.
